proposed_value: Creates a large-data-center framework and task force; to the fullest extent consistent with law, agencies defer substantive review and restrict discretionary support and incentives for projects not aligned, non-performing, or not seeking a determination until specified conditions are met; adds project disclosure and reporting duties. Coverage, exceptions, and prospective application are defined in the order.
recommended_value: Establishes a framework and task force for covered data centers, generally facilities at 25 MW or more or meeting the referenced statutory large-load definition, subject to stated exclusions; following specified review triggers, agencies defer substantive review for not-aligned, non-performing, or non-seeking projects until required local approvals, plan consistency, and required water or wastewater authorizations are documented, and limit discretionary incentives and support, to the extent lawful; disclosure and reporting conditions apply prospectively subject to transition protections.
rationale: Original is broadly right but obscures inclusive threshold, statutory alternative, triggers and conditions. Avoid treating all duties as unconditional.
follow_up: Retain detailed exclusions, transition and other dimensions in provenance.
